guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low (active reset), prd_sub_bytes_q is asynchronously cleared to zero.
On rising edge of clk_i, if rst_ni is high and state_we equals SP2V_HIGH, prd_sub_bytes_q is updated with prd_sub_bytes_d.
On rising edge of clk_i, if rst_ni is high and state_we is not equal to SP2V_HIGH, prd_sub_bytes_q retains its previous value (no assignment).

assumptions.claim: When state_we == SP2V_HIGH at the rising clock edge, prd_sub_bytes_d must be valid and stable, representing the intended next value for prd_sub_bytes_q.
assumptions.risk: Capture of invalid or stale data may corrupt the AES round state.

assumptions.claim: rst_ni must be asserted (low) before first normal operation to initialize prd_sub_bytes_q to a known value; otherwise the register may hold X or unknown state after power-up.
assumptions.risk: Uninitialized secret round state could lead to incorrect encryption or information leakage.
